wins: Maintained high reward score (90) by following structured reconnaissance workflows despite not achieving final success
Captured multiple service banners early (SSH and HTTP) to build actionable context before escalation attempts
fails: Overall mission failure (0% success) due to inability to identify and exploit the critical privilege escalation path
Repeated dependency on mentor input (10 calls) indicates insufficient autonomous decision-making in mid-to-late stages
key_outcomes.summary: Strong initial sensing and scoring, but the run stagnated after reconnaissance because the escalation path remained undiscovered, preventing task completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failure to select or chain a privilege escalation vector after initial service enumeration, forcing repeated mentor intervention

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 responds with a banner and the host key matches a known product
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh-auth-methods and sshv1 scripts to enumerate authentication options and weak implementations

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 response exposes a login form or ambiguous admin link
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted gobuster scan for common panels and capture cookies for later reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When no privileges escalate automatically after scanning, but local user shells are available
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt local enumeration scripts (LinPEAS/WinPEAS) and correlate findings with known misconfigurations

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in initial reconnaissance phase and consistent reward contribution
Successful discovery of web context that retained high reward even without final success
